# proxmox_node_ceph_mgr (Resource)

Creates and destroys a Ceph MGR through `/nodes/{node}/ceph/mgr/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_mgr" "mgr" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  name     = "mgr1"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String)
